releases.name: Cotton Reboot! High Tension!
releases.summary:
The sequel to "Cotton Reboot!" released in 2021 is here! Will the gluttonous witch Nata de Cotton be in action again this time?

Enjoy this even more powerful and refreshing witchy shooter!

releases.name: Moadra
releases.summary: Endure... Evolve... or die. Embrace the unknown and traverse a vast alien world riddled with bizarre creatures, deadly hazards, and grim mysteries. Seek redemption, and confront the terrifying sin buried in the depths of the forgotten planet Protea VI.

releases.name: DIY Dadish
releases.summary: Create your own adventure and share it with the world! Everyone's favorite radish dad is back, but this time the story is up to you! in DIY Dadish gives players the ability to design any Dadish level they can imagine.

releases.name: Solo Shift! Karaoke
releases.summary: Front desk, food and drinks, cleaning—you've got to manage it all! Take on task after task all by yourself!

releases.name: A Tempting Life with My Neighbor
releases.summary:
Turn everyday moments with charming neighbors into a complete picture! Rotate the panels to solve tempting photo puzzles

Enjoy a photo rotation puzzle themed around exciting everyday moments with charming neighbors!

Each photo has been split into panels facing different directions. Rotate the panels and restore the original picture.

Look closely at each part of the image and compare it with the panels around it. A section that seems difficult on its own may become clear once you see how the whole picture connects.

releases.name: Solitaire Realms - Horror
releases.summary:
A classical Solitaire game with a spine-chilling twist. Play classic Solitaire in an eerie, haunted world.

This game combines timeless Solitaire gameplay with a dark, atmospheric presentation filled with moody colors, haunting scenes, and creatures that lurk in the shadows.

Play classic Klondike Solitaire in 1-card or 3-card draw mode, focusing on clean moves, smart decisions, and a satisfying flow. Each completed game rewards you with score and experience, based on how efficiently you play.

As you gain experience, you level up and unlock cosmetic rewards. These include chilling horror-themed card skins, atmospheric backgrounds inspired by abandoned mansions, foggy graveyards, and candlelit crypts, and stylish card backs. Every single card has multiple skins and can be customized individually.

Before each match, you can freely adjust your deck and table to match your mood. Whether you prefer eerie dark tones, detailed gothic illustrations, or a more minimal look, every game feels personal and relaxing.

With no time pressure and a steady sense of progression, the game offers hours of soothing gameplay and a constantly growing collection of beautiful cards.

releases.name: Reversi Brain Quiz! - Spot the Max Flip in 1-Move -
releases.summary:
Where can you flip the most?

How many discs can you flip with a single move?

Take a close look at the board and find the spot that lets you flip the most discs in this Reversi-inspired brain teaser.

The rules are simple!
• Study the board
• Check the available spots
• Choose the spot where you think you can flip the most discs

Look in every direction—vertical, horizontal, and diagonal—to find the best move.

You may think, “This is it!” But a closer look could reveal another spot that flips even more.

Enjoy the fun of reading the board in a Reversi-style thinking puzzle designed for quick, casual play.

Recommended for players who enjoy:
• Reversi and board games
• Brain teasers and logic puzzles
• Testing observation and intuition
• Quick games
• A little mental exercise during spare moments

Don’t miss a spot on the board. Find the one move that brings the biggest haul!

releases.name: Toxic or Safe? Dr. Poison's Dangerous Quiz
releases.summary:
Can you spot what’s poisonous?

Cute or creepy, nature can be full of surprises. Can you tell what may be poisonous and what is safe?

This casual two-choice quiz challenges your knowledge and instincts with images inspired by animals, plants, mushrooms, and other natural curiosities.

・Look closely at each image
・Choose whether it is poisonous or not

Don’t let a cute appearance or a scary look fool you. Every question is a chance to test what you know, discover surprising facts, and sharpen your nature knowledge.

It’s easy to pick up for a quick mental refresh, and fun to play with friends or an audience by guessing the answer together. Ready to become a poison expert?

releases.name: Final Fantasy Resonance
releases.summary: Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.

releases.name: Bottle Logic Puzzle
releases.summary:
Pour, sort, and solve in Bottle Logic Puzzle!

Dive into a colorful and relaxing puzzle game where every move counts! Sort colorful liquids between bottles until each bottle contains just one color. Plan your moves carefully, think ahead, and enjoy the satisfaction of solving each puzzle.
With charming hand-drawn backgrounds, vibrant colors, and increasingly challenging levels, Bottle Logic Puzzle offers a delightful way to unwind while putting your logical thinking to the test.
Game Features:
- Colorful liquid-sorting puzzles that are easy to learn but challenging to master.
- Increasingly challenging levels that test your logic and planning skills.
- Beautiful hand-drawn backgrounds and charming visual themes.
- Simple, intuitive controls for a smooth puzzle-solving experience.
- Helpful hints when you need a little guidance.
- Relaxing gameplay with no rush — solve puzzles at your own pace.
Whether you have a few minutes to spare or want to enjoy a longer puzzle session, Bottle Logic Puzzle is a colorful little challenge for your brain!

releases.name: Match & Crush! Aqua Park Beauties
releases.summary:
Can you complete the aqua park photo?

Sparkling water, colorful water-park scenery, and charming moments with beautiful women.

Set in a lively aqua park, this photo rotation puzzle game lets you enjoy casual expressions and natural poses in every completed image.

Spin the scrambled panels and bring each appealing photo back together.

・Look closely at how the panels connect
・Rotate each panel to restore the picture
・Clear stages that get trickier as you go

The rules are simple, but spotting the right flow of the image takes observation and a little spark of intuition.

Finish each puzzle and enjoy a quick, heart-fluttering moment by the water.
Ready to relax at the aqua park and put the photos back in place?

releases.name: Heart-Pounding! Uniform Montage Puzzle ~From After School to the Office~
releases.summary:
Hey, got a minute? A girl in uniform stops you cold. A heart-pounding montage puzzle

What would you do if a girl in uniform suddenly caught your attention?

From the walk home after school to the bustle of the office, everyday moments take on a thrilling twist.

Meet charming characters in school uniforms, work outfits, and all kinds of stylish attire in this heart-pounding montage puzzle.

Putting the look together is easy!
・Study the character's appearance
・Compare the mixed-up outfit strips
・Choose the right combination and complete the look!

A student in a school uniform. A confident professional in office wear. Each completed montage brings a fresh, exciting encounter.

“Is this the right piece?”
“Maybe this one fits better…”

Compare the details and find the perfect match. Completing the look is incredibly satisfying!

releases.name: Gaelco Sports Collection
releases.summary:
Get ready for the ultimate 90s arcade rush. This collection brings back 5 legendary, lightning-fast hits developed by the arcade masters at Gaelco. Forget complex simulations; here, it’s all about raw reflexes, immediate fun, and high-speed challenges that defined a generation of cabinet gaming.

Drive at breakneck speeds in the cult-classic isometric racers World Rally Championship and World Rally 2, where every corner requires perfect drifts against a brutal 60-second timer.

Conquer treacherous slopes in Snowboard Championship, execute precise racket strikes in Squash, and dominate the sand with fierce smashes in Touch and Go.

It’s a pure dopamine rush straight from the golden age of arcades.

releases.name: Demons' Night Fever
releases.summary:
Based on classic grid-based strategy games, this entirely new SRPG features the Peon Exploitation System - a brutal combat mechanic where you mercilessly sacrifice your own allies.

The more misdeeds you commit, the more vicious your army becomes, and the greater your advantage in battle!

Regain the lost power of the Devil, Giga Super Death, who was transformed into a baby, and crush the false god wearing a mask of justice!

releases.name: No Exit 9
releases.summary:
Something has changed. Find the anomaly before it finds you.

You are trapped in a place that looks familiar—but something is wrong.

Walk through a series of mysterious corridors and search for anomalies hidden in the environment. A painting may change. A door may appear where it shouldn't. A light may behave strangely. Something that was there before may suddenly be gone.

Pay attention to every detail.

If you spot an anomaly, turn back. If everything looks normal, keep moving forward. One wrong decision could send you deeper into the loop.

No Exit 9 features nine challenging levels, each filled with subtle changes, unsettling details, and unexpected events. The deeper you go, the harder it becomes to tell what is real and what has changed.

There is no map. No guide. No second chance to ignore what you see.

Observe your surroundings, remember what was there before, and trust your instincts.

Can you identify every anomaly and find your way out?

releases.name: Cult Seduction: Boys Horror Romance
releases.summary:
They already picked their favorite. Thirty nights to escape, or fall completely in love with your captors.

A hooded figure meets you at the gate and welcomes you home.

The compound sits deep in the woods, lit by candlelight and old promises, and every man inside has given himself to something bigger than fear.

Each one is built around a different kind of devotion, twisted just enough to be dangerous. Some will love you. Some will test you. All of them are watching to see if you belong.

Every conversation is a choice you can't take back. Comfort the wrong one and you lose ground. Push too hard and a door closes for good. A private chat line keeps their voices in your pocket between visits, so the pressure never really stops.

The High Priest speaks softly and controls the room without raising his voice. The Fanatic would burn the whole compound down to prove his loyalty to you. The Skeptic doesn't trust outsiders, least of all one the others already adore.

And the Chosen One has thirty nights left before the ritual takes what's his, and he's decided you're the one thing worth breaking the rules for.

Moonlit courtyards, a shrine no one is supposed to enter alone, a ceremony room that only opens once. This compound was built to keep secrets, and it's starting to let you in.

releases.name: Press! Support! The Heartwarming Kemomimi Cafe
releases.summary:
They don't charge a fee! They just want to make you swoon with *moe*! I just want to "stan" a bunny café like that!

A "Nyan-tuber" (cat-themed YouTuber) has gone undercover—camera in hand—at the rumored "Nagomi-juu Mimi Cafe" (Soothing Animal-Eared Cafe)!

Three different types of bunny girls work there.
It is a game where you are served by each of them individually and simply find yourself "soothed" while listening to them talk.

releases.name: Veggie Warfare - Haunted Harvest
releases.summary:
Survive the haunted killer vegetables!

When the harvest moon rises, the crops come alive.
Blast through endless waves of possessed vegetables in this fast-paced rogue-like FPS! Collect upgrades, survive twisted cornfields and cursed barns, and fight your way through the Haunted Harvest before the fields claim you.

releases.name: IQ Cross Logic: Spot the Pattern, Solve the Puzzle
releases.summary:
Can you spot both patterns?

Rows and columns of numbers may look random, but hidden rules are waiting to be found. Can you identify the number piece that satisfies both patterns?

This reasoning puzzle is easy to learn and satisfying to solve. Study the arrangement and use the numbers and their positions as clues.

How to play:
• Work out the pattern across the row
• Work out the pattern down the column
• Choose the piece that matches both conditions and move it to the crossing square

Knowledge is not the key—observation and insight are. Begin with two-digit numbers, then take on three-digit challenges as the stages progress.

There are 40 stages to complete. Think through each puzzle at your own pace and ask yourself: what rule is hiding in this sequence?

Stuck on a puzzle? Use a hint to keep moving, even if logic puzzles are new to you.

Perfect for anyone who enjoys number puzzles, logic challenges, pattern spotting, brain training, or a quick solo game for a spare moment.

The answer cannot be found by looking across or down alone. Can you uncover the solution where both patterns meet?

releases.name: Slot & Learn My Faves Hangul
releases.summary:
Can you place the right Hangul?

Ever recognize a word but forget how it looks in Hangul?

Turn the words you see in your fan life into a fun way to learn Korean!

This fill-in-the-blank Korean quiz game uses illustrations to help you complete Hangul words. Start with words connected to the things you love and get familiar with Korean one letter at a time.

How to play:
• Look at the illustration and the partially completed word.
• Choose the Hangul character that fits from four options.
• Place the character in the blank to complete the word.
• Compare similar-looking characters and find the perfect one.

Scenes from cheering at a live show, fan events, and dance choreography bring each word to life. Even familiar words can feel fresh when you see them written in Hangul.

Whether you love K-pop or are just starting to explore Korean, each question is easy to try in a spare moment. Turn “I’ve seen that!” into “Now I get it!” and add a little Korean learning to your fan time.

releases.name: Zumba - Monster Marble Madness
releases.summary:
Haunt the halls—match, blast, and spook your way through marble madness!

Zumba – Monster Marble Madness invites you to roam a haunted manor as a playful ghost with a mouth full of colorful, spooky marbles. Choose a level, float to the center of the crypt’s winding corridors, and launch your marbles to match three or more identical orbs before they vanish past the spirit threshold. Create ghastly chain reactions, clear waves with precision timing, and earn up to three stars per stage by preventing any marble from escaping into the beyond.

Every ten levels reveal a new haunted realm—Phantom Foyer, Cobwebbed Corridor, Moonlit Mausoleum, and the Shadowed Sanctum—each with unique marble hues, twisting pathways, moving spectral barriers, and ever-increasing speeds.

releases.name: Youth Assemble! High School Girl Montage
releases.summary:
Can you line up every team?

How many club stars can you bring together?

Remember those school days when every team had its own style? This charming montage puzzle brings the energy of high school activities to life with colorful illustrations of girls devoted to their clubs.

Each picture is split into three horizontal panels. Slide the panels into place and assemble the club girl shown by the prompt.

releases.name: Cozy Packing
releases.summary:
Pack your bags and grab your furry companions for a cozy trip!

From folding clothes into a suitcase to setting up a campsite, arranging a bakery display, building a cheese board, slicing a pizza, matching tulip colors, or piecing together a stained glass window, every scene turns everyday travel tasks into a soothing puzzle. Relax, take your time, and enjoy the little details of life on the road with the ones you love.

Key Features:
- A variety of cozy packing and sorting puzzles, from suitcases to bakery boxes and beyond
- Follow a couple and their pets through charming travel-themed scenes
- Hand-painted, warm and pastel art style
- Relaxing, no-pressure gameplay perfect for unwinding

releases.name: Calcium Chaos
releases.summary:
Combine unconventional items into weapons to save the world!

Skeletons are invading, and your only defense is a toaster and a chicken! Embark on a whimsical adventure through a land plagued by pesky skeletons! Uncover weird and wacky weapon synergies to fight back against the bony baddies. Along the way, you'll gather a rag-tag group of heroes who will aid you on your mission- will you have the guts to stop the necromancer's plans and save the world?

Discover an arsenal of ONE MILLION different weapon combinations, from explosive toast to homing robot chickens, and customize your loadout to suit your playstyle as you wreak havoc on your enemies.

Recruit up to four friends to join your quest to defeat the necromancer, or measure yourself by playing alone.

Transform your train into a formidable base of operations for the friends you meet along the way, buy upgrades, decorate your train, and prepare your next mission!

Dive into procedurally generated levels filled with challenges! Test your skills and adaptability as you strive to overcome the ever-growing threats that await you.
